# row sums of a 2x3 i32 matrix: out[i] = m[i][0] + m[i][1] + m[i][2]
%mb = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%ob = buffer 2 dtype=i32 slot=1
%m  = load %mb
%m2 = reshape %m shape=[2 3]
%r  = reduce %m2 op=add pop=1
%r2 = shrink %r 0 shape=[2]
%s  = store %ob %r2
%o1 = after %ob %s
hints: `reduce pop=1` always folds the first axis. On a `[2 3]` matrix that's the column direction.
To add along each row, the row's elements have to be on the first axis: transpose first.
`permute order=[1 0]` gives `[3 2]`. Then `reduce op=add pop=1` leaves `[2]`, one sum per original row.
explain: reduce only pops leading axes, so you move the axis you want to fold to the front with permute. i32 adds wrap, so a row holding INT_MAX and 1 sums to INT_MIN.
title: Row sums with permute
